source_note: docs/content-drafts/gujcet-eligibility.md -- DRAFT RESEARCH, not verified, not published, and by far the least-confirmed of the three drafts this rules lane used: age, minimum marks and domicile are each explicitly 'not found, needs manual verification' (facts 2-4), and even the one loosely-attested item (fact 1, the PCM/PCB merit-group grouping) is labelled 'unclear-needs-verification' because the clause text sits inside a scanned, non-text-extractable PDF. Per this task's own instruction, this module reads the draft for SHAPE only, never values: every number below (the age, the marks thresholds) is INVENTED for engine-test purposes only and does not appear anywhere in the draft. Only the *shape* is drawn from it -- an any-of Physics/Chemistry/(Mathematics or Biology) subject-group split mirroring the draft's own PCM ('Merit Group: PCM') vs PCB ('Merit Group: PCB') framing, and this rule set's jurisdiction is Gujarat (GJ), matching GUJCET/ACPC being a Gujarat state-specific exam -- distinct from NEET-UG's IN-wide jurisdiction, demonstrating app.rules.ruleset's jurisdiction guard for a real state-scoped case.

cases.name: meets_all_criteria_general_category_with_pcm
cases.reason: Age, PCM subjects and marks all clear the synthetic thresholds.

cases.name: meets_with_pcb_biology_instead_of_mathematics
cases.reason: The any-of group accepts Biology as an alternative to Mathematics (the PCB merit group).

cases.name: does_not_meet_missing_third_subject
cases.reason: Neither Mathematics nor Biology was studied.

cases.name: does_not_meet_missing_physics
cases.reason: Physics, its own required group, is missing.

cases.name: does_not_meet_too_young
cases.reason: Will not have completed the synthetic minimum age by the cutoff.

cases.name: meets_exact_age_boundary
cases.reason: Turns the minimum age exactly on the cutoff day, which meets, not fails.

cases.name: insufficient_information_unknown_date_of_birth
cases.reason: Date of birth is not given, so the age cutoff can't be checked.

cases.name: insufficient_information_unknown_subjects
cases.reason: Subjects studied are not given, so the any-of group can't be checked.

cases.name: meets_reserved_category_lower_threshold
cases.reason: 42% clears the lower synthetic SEBC threshold (40%) even though it would fail the General threshold (45%).

cases.name: does_not_meet_marks_below_general_threshold
cases.reason: 42% is below the synthetic General threshold of 45%.

cases.name: insufficient_information_unknown_category_marks_below_ceiling
cases.reason: 42% clears no listed category's threshold ceiling and the category is unknown, so it can't be resolved -- never a guessed rejection.

cases.name: meets_unknown_category_marks_above_every_threshold
cases.reason: 46% clears even the strictest (General, 45%) synthetic threshold, so no category could have made this student fail.

cases.name: insufficient_information_stale_cycle_masks_a_would_be_meets
cases.reason: as_of is past the 2027 cycle's cycle_end -- a would-be meets is downgraded so a lapsed cycle is never a confident pass.

cases.name: does_not_meet_survives_a_stale_cycle
cases.reason: A real failure (too young) found under a lapsed cycle's rules is still true information.
